description: End-to-end compliance, audit, and regulatory control workflow for managing APIs on a TaasDeep API gateway, covering policy design, impact analysis, staged rollout, monitoring, and rollback.

api_id.description: Unique identifier for an API registered in the TaasDeep gateway.

environment_id.description: Unique identifier for an environment (e.g., dev, staging, prod, region-specific).

policy_id.description: Unique identifier for a compliance or gateway policy document.

policy_version_id.description: Unique identifier for a specific version of a policy.

deployment_id.description: Unique identifier for a gateway deployment instance of policies and configurations.

change_request_id.description: Unique identifier for a compliance change request tracking a set of policy updates.

audit_log_id.description: Unique identifier for a recorded audit log event or batch.

risk_assessment_id.description: Unique identifier for a risk/impact assessment associated with a change request.

rollback_plan_id.description: Unique identifier for a rollback plan generated for a specific deployment or change request.

approval_workflow_id.description: Unique identifier for the multi-step approval workflow associated with a change request.

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: create_compliance_change_request
functions.description: Create a new compliance change request to modify API gateway policies across environments.

title.description: Human-readable title of the compliance change request.

description.description: Detailed description of the intent, scope, and business justification.

requested_by.description: Information about the requester of this change.

target_apis.description: APIs impacted by this change request.

environments.description: Environments in which this change is requested.

traffic_segment.description: Optional traffic segment or tenant group to which the policy applies.

regulatory_context.description: List of regulatory frameworks and controls relevant to this change.

control_id.description: Control identifier within the selected framework (e.g., A.12.4.1).

change_window.description: Preferred implementation window for this change.

tags.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata for classification and filtering.

functions.returns: Newly created change_request_id, initial status, and associated approval_workflow_id.

functions.name: design_compliance_policy
functions.description: Design or update a compliance policy document as part of an existing change request.

policy_id.description: Existing policy to update; omit to create a new policy.

definition.description: Structured policy definition with nested rules.

version.description: Semantic version of the policy definition schema.

clients.description: Client-specific filters (e.g., API keys or app IDs).

actions.description: Policy actions to apply when match conditions are satisfied.

items.description: JSONPath or field name to mask.

change_notes.description: Description of what is being changed in this revision relative to previous versions.

functions.returns: Created or updated policy_id and policy_version_id linked to the specified change_request_id.

functions.name: run_policy_risk_assessment
functions.description: Run automated and manual risk assessment for a policy version as part of a change request.

environment_context.description: Context of environments where the policy will be applied.

manual_inputs.description: Optional manual risk input from security/compliance officers.

functions.returns: risk_assessment_id with calculated scores, qualitative risk rating, and recommended approval requirements.

functions.name: start_compliance_approval_workflow
functions.description: Start or update a multi-step approval workflow for a compliance change request based on risk assessment.

existing_approval_workflow_id.description: If provided, adds additional steps or reconfigures an existing approval workflow.

approval_matrix.description: Definition of required approval stages and roles.

required_roles.description: Roles that can approve this stage.

functions.returns: approval_workflow_id with current stage, pending approvers, and overall approval status.

functions.name: record_compliance_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approval or rejection decision for a specific stage in the approval workflow.

attachments.description: Optional evidence or documents attached to the decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval workflow status, including whether the change request is now fully approved, rejected, or requires changes.

functions.name: plan_compliance_deployment
functions.description: Generate a deployment plan and rollback plan for applying approved policy changes to specific environments.

target_environments.description: Environments where this deployment will be executed.

traffic_slices.description: For canary or phased rollout, define incremental traffic slices.

hold_duration_seconds.description: Duration to wait before moving to the next slice.

pre_deployment_checks.description: Checks to be executed before deployment starts.

post_deployment_checks.description: Checks to be executed after deployment completes.

functions.returns: Planned deployment_id and rollback_plan_id with structured steps and validation checks.

functions.name: execute_compliance_deployment
functions.description: Execute the planned compliance deployment to the API gateway and track real-time status.

dry_run.description: If true, simulates the deployment without applying changes.

execution_options.description: Fine-grained execution options for this run.

target.description: Destination identifier, e.g., email address or webhook URL.

functions.returns: Updated deployment status, per-environment progress, and links to live monitoring dashboards.

functions.name: get_compliance_deployment_status
functions.description: Get real-time or recent status for a compliance deployment, including policy violation metrics.

include.description: Additional data to include in the response.

time_window.description: Time window for metrics and logs.

relative_minutes.description: Alternative to from/to; look back this many minutes from now.

functions.returns: Current deployment phase, per-environment status, and requested metrics/violation summaries.

functions.name: trigger_compliance_rollback
functions.description: Trigger a partial or full rollback using a pre-computed rollback plan when issues are detected.

environment_ids.description: Limit rollback to these environments when scope is environment_subset.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation for triggering a rollback.

functions.returns: Rollback execution status, affected environments, and links to rollback audit logs.

functions.name: search_compliance_audit_logs
functions.description: Search compliance-related audit logs for API gateway events, policy changes, and access attempts.
functions.returns: List of audit_log entries matching the filters, including pagination metadata and a summary histogram by event_type.

functions.name: generate_regulatory_compliance_report
functions.description: Generate a structured compliance report for a set of APIs, environments, and frameworks, suitable for auditors.

frameworks.description: Regulatory frameworks to include in the report.

report_label.description: Optional label or name to appear on the report.

functions.returns: Generated report metadata including download URL, report_id (audit_log_id), and high-level compliance status summary.

functions.name: retry_failed_compliance_step
functions.description: Retry a previously failed step in the compliance workflow, such as a deployment stage or pre-check.

failed_step_id.description: Identifier of the failed workflow step to retry.

retry_strategy.description: Strategy configuration for the retry attempt.

override_execution_options.description: Optional overrides for execution behavior during retry.

reason.description: Operator-provided reason or justification for the retry.

functions.returns: Status of the retry initiation, new step execution id, and updated workflow state for the change_request.

functions.name: cancel_compliance_change_request
functions.description: Cancel an in-progress compliance change request, optionally rolling back relevant deployments.

reason.description: Reason for canceling the change request.

cancel_options.description: Options controlling how cancellation is performed.

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation, final status of the change_request, and summary of any rollbacks performed.

functions.name: search_apis
functions.description: Faceted search across api records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for api_gateway_compliance_flow.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of api records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_apis_by_status
functions.description: List api records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of api records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_api_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single api record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A api record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_apis
functions.description: Submit a batch of api records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_apis
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many api records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_apis
functions.description: Soft-archive api records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_apis
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of api records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_api_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for api lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_api_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created api event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_api_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a api including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_api_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for api_gateway_compliance_flow with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_api_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a api_gateway_compliance_flow operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_api_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled api_gateway_compliance_flow job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_api_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a api_gateway_compliance_flow execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_api_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a api prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.name: submit_api_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a api for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.name: record_api_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending api approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_api
functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached api to a higher tier with paging and audit.

target_team.description: Team or rota receiving the escalation

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_api_comment
functions.description: Append a comment, optionally with @mentions and visibility scope, to a api.

mentions.description: User ids mentioned in the body

parent_comment_id.description: Comment id this one replies to

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Newly created comment record including comment_id and resolved mentions.

functions.name: attach_api_evidence
functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a api with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Attachment descriptor including attachment_id, content hash, and stored URI.

functions.name: snapshot_api_state
functions.description: Capture a point-in-time snapshot of a api and its dependencies for restore or audit.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor with snapshot_id, captured size, and storage URI.

functions.name: restore_api_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a api (and optionally dependencies) from a previously captured snapshot.

new_owner_id.description: Owner of the restored record when mode=new_record

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Restore job descriptor with conflicts surfaced and final record id.

functions.name: get_api_metrics_summary
functions.description: Compute summary KPIs for api_gateway_compliance_flow over a time window with optional segmentation.

metrics.description: Metric names to compute (e.g. throughput, p95_latency, failure_rate)

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

compare_to_previous_period.description: Include delta vs the previous equal-length window

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A metrics document with per-bucket values, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: create_api_dashboard
functions.description: Define a dashboard layout combining charts and tables for api_gateway_compliance_flow.

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Dashboard descriptor including dashboard_id and resolved share list.

functions.name: define_api_policy
functions.description: Create or version a policy controlling allowed api_gateway_compliance_flow behaviour.

rules.description: Ordered rule list, first match wins

when.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.name: evaluate_api_policies
functions.description: Evaluate the active api_gateway_compliance_flow policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregate verdict, per-rule outcomes, and any obligations attached to the decision.

functions.name: link_api_dependencies
functions.description: Declare typed dependency links between a api and related artifacts to drive impact analysis.

replace_existing.description: Replace prior links of the same relations

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Resulting link set with created, updated, and removed entries.
